product_metadata.title: Mini Sola Wood Flower Assortment - 50 in a Set
features: An assortment of 50 small (1-1.5") sola wood flowers
description: Hands down one of our favorite assortments, the mini assortment! These flowers may be itty bitty but don’t let their size fool you they make a bit mark in sola wood flower arrangements! Use the minis to fill in those little holes in an arrangement. Make a tiny cute little arrangement. Use them for interest in home decor pieces. Seriously, we can't get enough of these mini flowers! Features: -50 flowers -sizes ranging from 1-1.5 inches -random pick of different style mini flowers currently in stock no two orders will be the same. Please note these sola wood flowers are handmade and there can be a slight difference in size and shape from flower to flower. Sola flowers are not fresh flowers. They are handmade wood flowers. The texture is similar to a thin version of balsa wood. Because they are handmade and made from natural materials, no two are exactly alike! Brown veining, occasional small holes from a "knot" in the wood are on the flowers. Please note that these flowers do not come with stems.
